title: Continue VS Code 1.3.39 and JetBrains 1.0.68 Release
description: Release of VS Code extension version 1.3.39 and JetBrains plugin version 1.0.68, featuring 61 commits between March 25-27, 2026, including new provider support, session filtering, and numerous bug fixes.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: Filter Session History by Workspace Directory in Continue
description: Added optional workspaceDirectory field to ListHistoryOptions, allowing users to scope session lists to a specific workspace with case-insensitive filtering applied before pagination. Addresses issue #9936.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: .continue/configs Directory Support
description: Added support for loading local profiles from .continue/configs/ directory alongside existing .continue/agents/ and .continue/assistants/ directories, providing a third configuration location for better organization.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: ClawRouter Cost-Optimized Model Routing in Continue
description: Integration of ClawRouter as a new LLM provider that automatically selects the cheapest capable model for each request based on prompt complexity, providing 78-96% cost savings on blended inference costs. Added support for 'auto', 'free', and 'eco' models with full documentation.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: Chunk Large JCEF Messages for JetBrains
description: Implemented chunking for large JCEF messages to prevent JetBrains sidebar freezes, improving stability and responsiveness for JetBrains IDE users.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: Critical and High Security Vulnerability Fixes in Continue
description: Resolved critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities across dependencies, enhancing overall security posture.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: DeepSeek max_tokens to max_completion_tokens Mapping
description: Fixed OpenAI adapter to properly map max_tokens to max_completion_tokens parameter for DeepSeek reasoning models, ensuring correct API compatibility.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: Self-hosted Cloud Agents in Cursor
description: Cursor now supports self-hosted cloud agents that keep code and tool execution entirely in your own network. Your codebase, build outputs, and secrets all stay on internal machines running in your infrastructure, while the agent handles tool calls locally. Self-hosted cloud agents offer the same capabilities as Cursor-hosted cloud agents, including isolated VMs, full development environments, multi-model harnesses, and plugins.
author: Cursor Team

title: Ollama Tool Call Parsing Error Messages
description: Added actionable error messages when Ollama fails to parse tool calls, improving user experience by providing clear guidance when configuration or model issues occur.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: vLLM Provider Configuration Fixes
description: Fixed vLLM provider to properly respect user-configured contextLength and model settings, ensuring user configurations are properly applied.
author: Continue Dev Team

title: Allow Multiple Context Providers of Same Type
description: Updated config.yaml support to allow multiple context providers of the same type, providing greater flexibility for advanced configurations.
author: Continue Dev Team
